results.title: FG to inaugurate finished section of two Northern rail projects in December - Businessday NG
results.snippet:

The federal government is set to inaugurate the finished sections of two major railway projects in Northern Nigeria, the Kaduna–Kano Standard Gauge Railway and the Kano–Katsina–Maradi Railway, by December 3, 2026.
